Implementation: - `src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts` - `isElseIfBranch` detects `IfStatement` nodes that are else-if branches (parent `IfStatement` with `parent.alternate === node`). - `scanElseIfPrecedingComments`, `scanElseIfBetweenConditionAndBody`, and `scanElseIfInsideBlockComments` implement the multiple else-if comment locations. - `gatherElseIfCommentText(...)` (annotated with `@story docs/stories/026.0-DEV-ELSE-IF-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md`) implements position logic: - If `beforeText` already has `@story`/`@req`, it returns `beforeText` (preserves existing behavior). - If node is not an else-if, it returns `beforeText` unchanged. - For else-if: - Calls `scanElseIfPrecedingComments` and, if it contains `@story`/`@req`, returns that (before-else precedence). - If no valid preceding annotation and `hasValidElseIfBlockLoc(node)` is false, falls back to `beforeText`. - Otherwise calls `scanElseIfBetweenConditionAndBody` and, if any comment lines exist between condition and body, returns them. - If none, calls `scanElseIfInsideBlockComments` and returns inside-block comments if present. - Otherwise returns `beforeText`. - This matches REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION-ELSE-IF, REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC-ELSE-IF, and REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY-ELSE-IF. - `gatherBranchCommentText(...)` delegates: - For `SwitchCase` and `CatchClause`, uses existing specialized logic. - For `IfStatement`, calls `gatherElseIfCommentText(sourceCode, node, parent, beforeText)`, integrating else-if rules into the main branch comment gathering. - `getBranchAnnotationInfo(...)`: - Calls `gatherBranchCommentText(...)` to compute the combined annotation text; uses regexes to decide `missingStory`/`missingReq`. - For else-if branches with `BlockStatement` consequents, adjusts auto-fix insertion point: ```ts if (isElseIfBranch(node, parent) && node.consequent.type === "BlockStatement" && node.consequent.loc?.start) { const commentLine = node.consequent.loc.start.line + 1; const commentIndent = sourceCode.lines[commentLine - 1]?.match(/^(\s*)/ )?.[1] || indent; indent = commentIndent; insertPos = sourceCode.getIndexFromLoc({ line: commentLine, column: 0 }); } ``` - This places auto-fix annotations as the first line inside the block, aligned with Prettier behavior (REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX-ELSE-IF). - `reportMissingAnnotations(...)` obtains the parent via `context.getAncestors()` and passes it into `getBranchAnnotationInfo`, ensuring else-if detection has the necessary parent context. - `src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts` - Rule wiring unchanged but relies on updated helpers; `IfStatement` is in `DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES`, so else-if branches are covered by the rule as required by IMPL-IF-STATEMENT-HANDLER.
